    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AudioBook
    Immutable audio edition; delivery is explicitly physical or digital.
    CatalogData
    Immutable shared metadata, with edition-specific years 1450..2027.
    Checkout
    Application service depending on catalogue, discount and shipping abstractions.
    Delivery
    Fulfilment mode independent of content quality.
    DiscountStrategy
    External promotion policy, expressed as basis points (100 basis points = 1 percent).
    EBook
    Immutable downloadable e-book, with a 15 percent intrinsic discount when DRM is absent.
    EBookBuilder
    Reusable e-book builder: mandatory data, bytes and words; optional EPUB format and DRM enabled.
    EBookFormat
    Supported e-book formats; arbitrary strings cannot enter the domain model.
    InMemoryCatalog
    One LinkedHashMap owns ordering and uniqueness; expected O(1) ID operations, O(n) snapshots.
    Magazine
    Immutable magazine with validated subtype data.
    Main
    Useful baseline demonstration; extension exercises are listed in the handout.
    Material
    Closed family of immutable materials with shared identity and a final price algorithm.
    MaterialCatalog
    Mutation and query contract for an insertion-ordered catalogue of immutable materials.
    MaterialFactory
    Named, typed creation entry points.
    MaterialVisitor<R>
    Type-directed operation.
    Media
    Capability shared by materials consumed over time; physical delivery is a separate concern.
    PrintedBook
    Immutable printedbook with validated subtype data.
    ShippingVisitor
    Stateless shipping quotation: 50 cents per started 100 g, magazine flat 200, physical CD 50, physical DVD 100, and every digital delivery zero.
    VideoMaterial
    Immutable video with detached cast metadata; delivery is explicitly physical or digital.
